source_integration_method: exact separable integral over binary QSGS Ag voxels; contributions to round-off-only projected cells are omitted
limitations: Heat is deposited directly into lattice enthalpy; this is not TTM or TTM-MD.
Candidate properties are first-pass values pending source-table archival and citation review.
Boundary A/B are limiting assumptions, not measured Ag/Ti3SiC2 interface heat transfer.
External z faces are insulated and x/y are periodic; no free-surface radiation or convection is included.
The phase model does not include vaporization, so states above the Ag normal-boiling reference are outside its reliable regime.
Adiabatic cooling redistributes energy inside the computational domain and does not represent heat loss to an external sink.

tracked_liquid_persistence_screen.interpretation: Provisional user-defined screening only. IDs continue through overlap using the documented dominant-overlap rule; split children get new IDs and merged clusters inherit the largest-overlap parent. This is sampled continuity, not a universal thermal-stability criterion.

liquid_tracking.identity_rule: Largest-overlap child inherits parent on split; largest-overlap parent supplies ID on merge; all parent IDs remain in the event record.

energy_ledger_definition.total_enthalpy_J: Integral of the stored volumetric enthalpy field relative to uniform 300 K.
energy_ledger_definition.ag_latent_energy_J: Ag reference-density fusion latent heat multiplied by the stored Ag liquid fraction field.
energy_ledger_definition.sensible_enthalpy_J: Total enthalpy minus the Ag latent-energy term.
energy_ledger_definition.relative_energy_balance_error: (total enthalpy - cumulative injected energy) / cumulative injected energy.
